name: Chengdu Industrial Investment Group Co., Ltd. (成都产业投资集团有限公司)
via: large state-capital investment and operation platform company established by the Chengdu municipal government; holds 51% of Chengdu Rongjiu Liquor and is its controlling shareholder
note: Founded 27 December 2017 (registered capital 10 billion yuan) from the former Chengdu Industry Investment Group absorbing the city's agricultural-investment and technology-transfer companies, per Cover News (25 November 2025).
